target.title: chore: add provider and scheduler runtime evidence
target.body:
Fixes #101010

## What Problem This Solves

Provider and scheduler QA commands could report success without directly proving the runtime behavior they represent. Telegram startup lacked leased-token `getMe` evidence, heartbeat active-hours lacked a bounded real scheduler observation, and the OpenTelemetry smoke delegated production to a broader scenario instead of exercising the diagnostics exporter directly.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds three bounded executable proofs using the shared QA evidence writer: Telegram starts the real monitor only with a dedicated leased QA token and otherwise records blocked evidence without credential data; heartbeat runs the real scheduler through active, quiet-hours, and reloaded configuration states; and the OpenTelemetry smoke starts the diagnostics service directly against a contained OTLP receiver. The older child-process OpenTelemetry path is removed rather than retained as a compatibility layer.

## User Impact

Maintainers get contained runtime evidence for Telegram startup, heartbeat active-hours behavior, and exported telemetry. Generic `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` credentials are never consumed by the Telegram proof, and environments without a dedicated leased token produce an explicit blocked result rather than a false pass.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/telegram-bot-token-runtime.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/heartbeat-active-hours-runtime.test.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/qa-otel-smoke.e2e.test.ts` — 32 tests passed at `698984cb678b717b6a1aa69a0ebc61f171e53662`.
- Direct heartbeat executable — passed after observing an in-window fire, a quiet-hours skip, and a post-reload fire.
- Direct Telegram executable — recorded `blocked` with no dedicated leased token; a generic `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` also remains blocked and is not disclosed.
- Direct OpenTelemetry executable — passed with 5 spans, 6 metrics, 1 OTLP log, 1 trace request, 1 metric request, and 1 log request.
- Root dependency manifests and shrinkwrap are unchanged; the executables are invoked by direct file paths.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kww4af8ceg2nf05btch8w679` confirmed dedicated Telegram token and credential-broker inputs were absent. Hosted Vitest and direct execution were blocked before startup because delegated sync omitted tracked `extensions/qa-lab/src/mantis/cli.ts`; local exact-head proof above covers the changed surfaces.
- Fresh branch autoreview returned no accepted or actionable findings.
